title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Privilege… (CVE-2026-91893)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 contain an Improper Privilege Management vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially elevate their privileges. The vulnerability is classified as high severity with a CVSS score of 7.8, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability if exploited.
